ground_truth.main_content:
Pest Control Detroit MI

Expert Pest Control in Detroit, MI

The Motor City, Motown, Madonna, and Jack White; Tigers, Pistons, Redwings, and Lions, oh my. All of these are synonymous with Detroit. But what about the invention of Ginger Ale? The stat of greatest potato chip consumption per capita? How about the giant salt mine under the city? Who knew Detroit had all that going on?

Unfortunately, like most major cities, Detroit is also home to an overabundance of pests. Fortunately, Detroit residents don’t have to struggle against those pests alone. The experts at Plunkett’s Pest Control’s Detroit office are ready to help anytime pests start bugging you.

Common Detroit Pest Problems

Like any major city, The Motor City struggles with the kind of pest problems high-density living and constant transit bring. Rats, bed bugs, and other opportunistic pests thrive among Detroit’s homes and businesses. The city’s proximity to the water also helps humidity-dependent pests to reproduce quickly. But don’t worry! No matter how bad your pests, we have solutions.

Plunkett's Pest Control Services Detroit, MI

Plunkett’s is ready to help with all the pest control needs for your home or business. If you need help identifying your pest, check out our bug ID form! Get in touch with Plunkett’s whenever you need pest control expertise. Our local Detroit pest control experts have the knowledge, experience, and resources required to wipe out your pest infestation for good. Learn about some of the worst pest problems in the Detroit area and how Plunkett’s can help!

For over 100 years, Plunkett’s has delivered honest, expert, full-service pest management services to homes and businesses.
